result.reason: The redline makes targeted warranty changes and expressly carves them out of the disclaimer, but it omits every required warranty duration and the compliance-with-laws warranty. It also limits the workmanship warranty to Technical Support Services and materially qualifies the documentation-conformance warranty. The remedy language is operative, but “non-conforming period” is undefined and may not fit one-time services, malicious-code breaches, or replacement remedies.
